            如何在 Web Worker 中高效传输大批量数据（&gt;10MB）

                    阅读3分钟
                  </span> <!----></div></div> <div style="flex:1;" data-v-61fb5e44=""></div> <!----> <!----></div> <!----> <!----> <!----> <!----> <div id="article-root" itemprop="articleBody" class="main" data-v-61fb5e44=""><div class="article-viewer markdown-body result"><p>Web Worker 是浏览器提供的一种运行多线程 JavaScript 的机制，能够显著提升前端应用的性能，避免阻塞主线程。但当你需要在主线程与 Worker 之间传输 <strong>大批量数据（如超过 10MB）</strong> 时，如果处理不当，会导致性能瓶颈、内存膨胀甚至浏览器卡顿。</p>
<p>这篇文章将带你深入了解 Web Worker 中 <strong>传输大数据的最佳实践与原理分析</strong>。</p>
<p><strong>注</strong>：</p>
<p>也欢迎大家阅读这篇文章的姊妹篇：<a href="https://juejin.cn/post/7546426755919527986" target="_blank" title="https://juejin.cn/post/7546426755919527986">实测告诉你：Web Worker 传输大字符串，哪种方法才不掉坑？</a></p>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-0">原理：postMessage 默认是“复制”不是“共享”</h2>
<p>Web Worker 与主线程之间通信依赖于 <a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fdeveloper.mozilla.org%2Fen-US%2Fdocs%2FWeb%2FAPI%2FWorker%2FpostMessage" target="_blank" title="https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Worker/postMessage" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer"><code>postMessage</code></a> API。默认行为如下：</p>
<ul>
<li>会通过 <strong>结构化克隆算法（structured clone algorithm）</strong> 将数据从一侧“复制”到另一侧。</li>
<li>对于大对象，这种克隆代价昂贵（CPU 和内存都会飙升）。</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts">worker.<span class="hljs-title function_">postMessage</span>(largeObject); <span class="hljs-comment">// ❌ 克隆大对象 → 慢 &amp; 占内存</span>
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-1">最佳方案：使用 Transferable Objects（可转移对象）</h2>
<h3 data-id="heading-2">什么是 Transferable Objects？</h3>
<p>某些对象（如 <code>ArrayBuffer</code>、<code>MessagePort</code>、<code>ImageBitmap</code>）可以在 <code>postMessage</code> 时通过“转移”（transfer）而非复制来传输。这样可以 <strong>零拷贝</strong>，避免 GC 和内存压力。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-3">示例：传输 ArrayBuffer</h3>
<h4 data-id="heading-4">主线程</h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> worker = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Worker</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'worker.js'</span>);

<span class="hljs-comment">// 创建一个 10MB 的 buffer</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> buffer = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">ArrayBuffer</span>(<span class="hljs-number">10</span> * <span class="hljs-number">1024</span> * <span class="hljs-number">1024</span>);

worker.<span class="hljs-title function_">postMessage</span>(buffer, [buffer]); <span class="hljs-comment">// ✅ 使用 transfer list</span>
<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(buffer.<span class="hljs-property">byteLength</span>); <span class="hljs-comment">// 0，buffer 已转移，不再可用</span>
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-5">Worker 内部</h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts">self.<span class="hljs-property">onmessage</span> = <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">event</span>) =&gt;</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> buffer = event.<span class="hljs-property">data</span>;
  <span class="hljs-comment">// buffer 是直接拥有的，不是拷贝的</span>
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 可以进一步处理，然后再传回主线程</span>

  self.<span class="hljs-title function_">postMessage</span>(buffer, [buffer]); <span class="hljs-comment">// 再次转移回主线程</span>
};
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-6">Transferable 和默认结构化克隆的对比</h2>





























<table><thead><tr><th>方式</th><th>是否复制数据</th><th>性能</th><th>适合传输</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>默认结构化克隆</td><td>✅ 拷贝</td><td>🐌 慢</td><td>小数据、结构化对象</td></tr><tr><td>Transferable Objects</td><td>❌ 不拷贝</td><td>⚡ 快</td><td><strong>大数据、二进制数据</strong></td></tr><tr><td>SharedArrayBuffer</td><td>❌ 共享访问</td><td>⚡⚡ 非常快</td><td>高性能并发访问场景</td></tr></tbody></table>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-7">⚠常见错误和陷阱</h2>
<h3 data-id="heading-8">忘记 transfer list</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts">worker.<span class="hljs-title function_">postMessage</span>(buffer); <span class="hljs-comment">// 没有 transfer list，会发生复制</span>
</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-9">尝试传输不可转移的对象（如普通对象或函数）</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts">worker.<span class="hljs-title function_">postMessage</span>({ <span class="hljs-attr">name</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'huge'</span>, buffer }); <span class="hljs-comment">// 如果结构中包含无法序列化的数据，会报错</span>
</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-10">传输之后继续使用已转移对象</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts">worker.<span class="hljs-title function_">postMessage</span>(buffer, [buffer]);
<span class="hljs-title function_">doSomething</span>(buffer); <span class="hljs-comment">// 报错：buffer.byteLength === 0，已经被转移</span>
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-11">进阶技巧</h2>
<h3 data-id="heading-12">1. 切片传输（Chunking）</h3>
<p>如果数据是复杂结构（如 JSON 数组），无法使用 Transferable，可以考虑分块传输：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> chunkSize = <span class="hljs-number">1024</span> * <span class="hljs-number">1024</span>; <span class="hljs-comment">// 1MB</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> i = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>; i &lt; totalSize; i += chunkSize) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> chunk = data.<span class="hljs-title function_">slice</span>(i, i + chunkSize);
  worker.<span class="hljs-title function_">postMessage</span>({ <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'chunk'</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">payload</span>: chunk });
}
</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-13">2. 使用 SharedArrayBuffer 实现共享内存</h3>
<p>适用于：</p>
<ul>
<li>高频次数据交换</li>
<li>多线程数据访问（需手动同步）</li>
</ul>
<p>⚠️ 注意：浏览器开启 COOP/COEP 才支持 <code>SharedArrayBuffer</code>。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> sharedBuffer = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">SharedArrayBuffer</span>(<span class="hljs-number">10</span> * <span class="hljs-number">1024</span> * <span class="hljs-number">1024</span>);
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> view = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Uint8Array</span>(sharedBuffer);

worker.<span class="hljs-title function_">postMessage</span>(sharedBuffer); <span class="hljs-comment">// 不需要 transfer list（是共享）</span>
</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-14">3. 使用 ImageBitmap 处理图像数据（如 Canvas）</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-title function_">createImageBitmap</span>(image).<span class="hljs-title function_">then</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">bitmap</span>) =&gt;</span> {
  worker.<span class="hljs-title function_">postMessage</span>(bitmap, [bitmap]); <span class="hljs-comment">// 可转移</span>
});
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-15">推荐实践总结</h2>






























<table><thead><tr><th>场景</th><th>推荐方式</th><th>说明</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>大批量二进制数据（如图像、点云、音频）</td><td>✅ Transferable Object（ArrayBuffer）</td><td>高性能首选</td></tr><tr><td>需要共享内存、多线程写入</td><td>✅ SharedArrayBuffer</td><td>高并发处理，需手动同步</td></tr><tr><td>数据结构复杂但较小</td><td>默认结构化克隆</td><td>无需转移</td></tr><tr><td>复杂结构且体积大</td><td>分片切割 + 结构化克隆</td><td>兼容性强</td></tr></tbody></table>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-16">工具推荐：封装一个通用数据传输器</h2>
<p>你可以封装一个 Web Worker 传输助手：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">sendDataToWorker</span>(<span class="hljs-params">worker: Worker, buffer: <span class="hljs-built_in">ArrayBuffer</span> | <span class="hljs-built_in">SharedArrayBuffer</span></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (buffer <span class="hljs-keyword">instanceof</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">ArrayBuffer</span>) {
    worker.<span class="hljs-title function_">postMessage</span>(buffer, [buffer]);
  } <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> {
    worker.<span class="hljs-title function_">postMessage</span>(buffer); <span class="hljs-comment">// SharedArrayBuffer 无需 transfer</span>
  }
}
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-17">小结</h2>
<p>当你在 Web Worker 中处理大数据时，<strong>选择合适的传输机制比代码优化更重要</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>✅ 使用 Transferable 避免深拷贝。</li>
<li>✅ 考虑 SharedArrayBuffer 实现零延迟共享。</li>
<li>✅ 对 JSON 等非二进制结构使用分片传输策略。</li>
<li>❌ 避免传输大型结构化对象或不必要的复制。</li>
</ul>
<p>合理使用这些技术，可以让你的 Web Worker 在处理大数据时既快又稳。</p></div></div>
